intelligence.enrichment: Earth attracts objects towards itself with gravitational force. This force acts without contact and is always attractive; an object thrown upward slows down, stops momentarily, changes direction, and then speeds up while coming down. Earth's attractive gravitational force -> object pulled toward Earth -> upward motion slows, direction changes, downward motion speeds up The learner correctly applies this rule: Earth attracts objects towards itself with gravitational force. This force acts without contact and is always attractive; an object thrown upward slows down, stops momentarily, changes direction, and then speeds up while coming down. An object thrown upward carries an upward force from the throw until that force runs out, and Earth only pulls once it starts falling.
